_comment: Hard gradient stops at NON-midpoint positions (css-images-3 §3.4.1: two stops at the same or crossing positions produce an abrupt transition; between stops at p1 < p2 the colour interpolates, so equal-position stops leave ZERO interpolation region). Every component degenerates its gradient to two solid regions so the v1 _expect fill/box model applies: the fill is the DOMINANT (larger) half and its bbox width reads the stop position directly off the pixels — an off-by-N stop-position resolution or a smeared hard stop (a runtime interpolating across some span, e.g. through a dithering ramp or a wrong premultiplied blend at the seam) shrinks or shifts the pure-fill bbox. Boxes are 160x40. ARITHMETIC — GSI_HardStop_RB: linear-gradient(90deg, #ff0000 60%, #0000ff 60%): red spans x[0,96) (0.60*160 = 96), blue x[96,160): red 3840 px > blue 2560 px -> fill red, box [96,40]. GSI_HardStop_Hue: #ff0000 55% -> #ffff00 55%: 0.55*160 = 88 -> red box [88,40]; red->yellow crosses a hue boundary, so a runtime wrongly synthesising an interpolation region (HSL/oklab smear) erodes the pure-red bbox at the seam. GSI_TwoSegment: 3 stops '#ff0000 0%, #ff0000 65%, #00ff00 65%' (explicit two-segment encoding of the same geometry — exercises stop-list normalisation rather than the 2-stop shortcut): 0.65*160 = 104 -> red box [104,40]. GSI_Control_Solid: solid red, box [160,40] — pins the canvas/AA behaviour of an unclipped 160-wide box so gradient rows are read against a measured control, not an assumption. boxTolerance 2 allows one AA column at the seam (a half-pixel seam position renders one blended column, excluded from the pure-fill bbox). Interpolation-SPACE questions (sRGB vs oklab midpoints) are deliberately out of scope for v1 — no single fill exists mid-ramp; that needs the v2 probe-points field (README). No predicted red.

_expect.note: css-images-3 §3.4.1 equal-position stops: hard seam at 0.60*160 = 96px; dominant red half asserted
hard stop across a hue boundary at 0.55*160 = 88px — a synthesised interpolation span erodes the pure-red bbox
solid control — pins full-width bbox reading so the gradient rows are judged against a measured canvas behaviour
